text:
Noah (Docs): Quick thread: updating the Dedicated provisioning quickstart to include an example for mixed-replica pools (gpu-small + gpu-large) and a note about autoscale policy precedence. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2456
Tariq (Infra): Love the example. One small thing: the terraform snippet uses `autoscale_policy = \"balanced\"` but our enum is `Balanced` in the provider. Case sensitivity matters in the CLI.
Noah (Docs): good catch, fixing to `Balanced`.
Elise (Eng): Also add a short note explaining fallback routing: if Balanced pool is saturated, requests will fallback to compatible model variants in other pools as per routing policy.
Clara (SRE): Add a troubleshooting tip: "If you see increased 429s after scaling up, check your route-level rate limits first (Console > Routes)."
Noah (Docs): added both notes and a short snippet showing how to set route limits in the console.
merge-bot: PR #2456 ready to merge after approvals
Tariq (Infra): one last ask: for mixed-replica examples, recommend `batch_limit` lower on gpu-small to avoid queue saturation. Add example: `batch_limit: 3` on small nodes.
Noah (Docs): added the batch_limit recommendation and a short sentence about quantization tradeoffs for small GPUs.
Elise (Eng): LGTM.
merge-bot: PR #2456 merged by Noah (Docs) after green CI
Noah (Docs): filed follow-up issue #438 to add a visual diagram for mixed pools in the provisioning guide. Closing thread.
